chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Ibn Faddal, from Abdullah ibn Bukayr, from Fadl Abu al-Abbas al-Baqbaq, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"The mother is not excluded from the one-third share except by two brothers or four sisters (from father and mother) or (by) two brothers (from the father)."
ai.seo_question: When does the mother's inheritance share reduce from one-third to one-sixth in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the specific condition for reducing the mother's inheritance share from one-third to one-sixth, a ruling derived from the verse 'For parents, a sixth share...' (Quran 4:11). It establishes that the presence of two or more siblings—whether full, paternal, or maternal—triggers this reduction, distinguishing it from the case of a single sibling which does not diminish her share in the same manner according to this narration.
